title: PLAYER 2 KILLS COUNT TOO
why: From the cloud code review (finding 24). In a co-op career raid, a kill that player 2 made did not count for his gun and could not earn him a trophy: the KILLS tally and the kill trophies were only fed from the host window. The kill word player 2 takes now counts the kill for the gun his last round came from, so his tally is banked at the end of his raid like the host, and killing the Overseer or the golden enemy earns him OVERSEER DOWN and GOLD HUNTER on his own save.
now: Player 2 kills now count for his gun tally and his trophies.
